shots.title: Hero

shots.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 24mm tilt-shift, corrected verticals
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph of cantilevered stone and glass villas on a ridge above the clouds in the Hajar mountains of Ras Al Khaimah. Golden-hour sun rakes across the facade, verticals perfectly straight, landscaped foreground, clear sky with open space above for a headline. It must feel built and lived-in, not rendered. No people. Overall look: misty mountain architecture photography, 24mm; colour palette of stone grey, mist white, pine green, warm wood. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
